lines.en: I charge along the cold current.

lines.zh: 我的身体在水里几乎不弯。
lines.en: My body barely bends in the water.
I ram once, then circle.

lines.zh: 我高速掠过一大片海床。
lines.en: I sweep across a wide stretch of seabed.
Water is flung aside as I turn.
I rise out of the icy deep.
I speed up along the cliff wall.
My fins slice the cold water.
I slowly tighten my circling.

lines.zh: 我冲出去时留下一道白痕。
lines.en: I leave a white streak when I charge.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴把水推到后面。
lines.en: My tail drives the water behind me.

lines.zh: 我朝着有动静的方向逼近。
lines.en: I close on the direction of any noise.
Each pass is closer than the last.
I sweep half a circle around you.
I dive, then surge up.
I skim past your hull.

lines.zh: 我在冷海里不快也不慢。
lines.en: In the cold sea I am neither fast nor slow.
I leave and swing back around.
I hang in the cold water, silent.
I stay still; the cold current circles me.
I wait for the next charge.

lines.zh: 冷海深处，我的尾鳍缓慢划着。
lines.en: Deep in the cold sea my tail fin sweeps slowly.
I draw my body into one line.

lines.zh: 我在听水里所有的声音。
lines.en: I listen to every sound in the water.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿在水里露出来。
lines.en: My teeth show through the water.

lines.zh: 我很久没有离开这片冷海。
lines.en: I have not left this cold sea in ages.
I turn my heading slowly.

lines.zh: 我浮在中层，像一段沉木。
lines.en: I hang midwater like sunken timber.
I wait for the water to cloud.
In the cold deep, I'm a rare sight.
My tail sweeps once, then stops.
I raise my eyes from the cold water.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的船看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at your hull for a long while.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿在水面下反光。
lines.en: My teeth glint under the surface.

lines.zh: 我不急，我已经找到你了。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; I have found you.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，眼睛一直朝你。
lines.en: I circle, eyes always on you.

lines.zh: 你听见水里有沉重的声音。
lines.en: You hear something heavy in the water.
I raise my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我对着你的方向张开嘴。
lines.en: I open my mouth toward you.
I do not call out, and need not.
My course wavers.
My fin stiffens.
A dark red spreads in the water.
I retreat into the cold water.

lines.zh: 我没有出声，只是慢下来。
lines.en: I make no sound, only slow.
I fix on you, colder now.
My teeth clamp.
I drop half a block.
I veer off and find a new angle.
One glance and I swim off.
That is not worth stopping for.
Out in the deep, I smell bait.
I would rather hunt something alive.
Bait is of no use to me.
I bump it and it breaks.
I swallow it with the water.
I turn back to look for you.
I do not even slow down.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身侧，被弹开很远。
lines.en: You hit my flank and are thrown far.

lines.zh: 我们撞出的力把水推开。
lines.en: Our impact shoves the water apart.
The planks crack loudly.
I scrape past your stern.
I hit a reef as I turn.
A wide patch of white churns up.
I am nudged off course.
You could not push me aside.
The surface gives a dull boom.
I turn back around.
Two cold-sea beasts swim side by side.
Our fins nearly touch.

lines.zh: 我们一起冲撞同一处水流。
lines.en: We charge the same current together.
It circles me once.
Our eyes meet for an instant.

lines.zh: 我们一起沉进更冷的水里。
lines.en: We sink into colder water together.
My tail crosses its tail.
Neither of us slows.
We swim far in parallel.
We rise toward the ice line.
I bite the bow of a sunken ship.
It sticks between my teeth.
I bite it in two.
I drag it into the reef.
I let go and it sinks.
I curl around it and look.
It does not interest me.

lines.zh: 沉下来的东西，没到底就进我肚子了。
lines.en: Whatever sinks gets swallowed before it reaches the bottom.
I halt in the water and turn to you.
The cold current brings the scent.
I begin accelerating toward you.
This time I will not merely brush past.
All my fins are spread.
The pressure leans your way.
I have put you in the middle.
I stop circling.
I lower my body to charge.
I have chosen this line.
I charge in, then swing wide.
I circle your boat.
Each pass is closer than the last.
You hear the second before impact.
I pass underneath the hull.

lines.zh: 我一直保持在这个深度。
lines.en: I hold at this depth.

lines.zh: 你的船开始移动得很慢。
lines.en: Your boat starts moving slowly.
I hit once and withdraw.
You cannot keep your footing.
I slam into the hull's side.
I bite down on the gunwale.
My head flips you over.
My tail lashes the surface.
You are knocked into the water.
I strike, wheel away, and return.
The water drives me straight in.
My teeth close beside you.
You grip the planks; I do not let go.

lines.zh: 这一撞把船撞出一个洞。
lines.en: The blow punches a hole in the hull.
The cold water suddenly churns.

lines.zh: 一个影子从深处升上来。
lines.en: A shadow rises from below.
A white cut opens on the surface.
This cold sea was quiet before.
I surface into this layer for the first time.

lines.zh: 你的船底下多了什么东西。
lines.en: Something is under your boat now.
The fish have scattered completely.
The pressure sits on your chest.
I appear, slowly.

lines.zh: 远处的冰线传来一声响。
lines.en: A sound comes from the ice line.

lines.zh: 水面上火在烧，我的背烫了一下。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface and my back sears.

lines.zh: 我被抛离水面，重重砸回去。
lines.en: I am thrown from the water and crash back down.

lines.zh: 我在水里被呛到了，这不该发生。
lines.en: I choke on water, which should not happen.

lines.zh: 爆风在水下撕开，我翻滚出去。
lines.en: The blast tears underwater and I tumble.
A bolt sinks into my flank.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的冲势按住了。
lines.en: That force halts my charge.
Hunger slows even my charges.

lines.zh: 雷打进冷水，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the cold water and numbs me.

lines.zh: 海也没了，我一路往下掉。
lines.en: The sea is gone; I fall and fall.
